purpose.zh: 低负荷练大腿后侧的屈膝控制
purpose.en: Train low-load knee-bending control with the hamstrings.

text.zh: 大腿不动，脚跟慢慢向臀部方向抬
text.en: Keep your thigh still and slowly lift your heel toward your glute

text.zh: 站直，单手轻扶稳固的椅子
text.en: Stand tall with one hand lightly on a stable chair.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.

commonErrors.en: Letting the thigh swing forward or bending at the waist.

cautions.zh: 扶稳无轮的椅子，疼痛或站不稳时就停止
cautions.en: Hold a stable chair without wheels, and stop if it hurts or you feel unsteady.
